question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We saw a ______ in the city last year.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3) **i.e. **‘gnu’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence implies that they saw something in the city last year.
 
• A noun will fill in the blank. **Gnu** is the only noun in the option.
 
• **Gnu:** **(कृष्णसार या कुरंग) **wildebeest; native to Eastern and Southern Africa.

Therefore, the complete sentence is *We saw a **gnu **__in the city last year.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Know (जानना)** - To have information in your mind, be aware of, or understand.
 
• **New** **(नया) **- Recently made or produced, not old.
 
• **No (नहीं)** - A negative answer or decision.
